decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed side extensions, due to their size, bulk and position, and the relative position of the neighbouring properties, would represent an obtrusive and overbearing development which would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers to the northeast, by reason of enclosure, loss of light and loss of outlook, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (October 2003).

Condition : 2 - The proposed extensions, due to their size, position and appearance, would fail to be secondary to the original end-of-terrace house and would detract from the original character of the house and street scene, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) and the Residential Extension Guidelines (October 2003).

Condition : 3 - Informative: The drawings submitted are inaccurate and there are discrepancies between the plans and elevations. As such it would not physically be possible to build the proposal. Therefore, if a revised application were submitted, the LPA would require an accurate measured survey of the existing house.
description: Erection of two storey side extension, single storey rear extension, dormer roof extension and front entrance porch to dwellinghouse.
